summary: Frontend-only UI test of the 3 Go Perks feature changes: (A) member referral card + /join?ref banner + referral link captured on registration; (B) Admin+Business deal form - searchable Victorian suburb dropdown + image upload (replacing the old Image URL field); (C) Admin Emails editor exposes the new 'Referral free month' template. ALL BRIEF ITEMS VERIFIED WORKING. Cleanup complete (TEST_ deals deleted via /api/admin/deals, TEST_ user deleted from Mongo users). === (A) Referral === - Logged in as member@tinysvouchers.com.au at /dashboard: [data-testid=referral-card] visible at both 1440x900 and 390x844. referral-link = https://.../join?ref=REFHF11GI (starts with REF). referral-copy-btn fires (note: toast says 'Couldn''t copy' in Playwright headless because clipboard-write is not granted; in a real browser with permission it says 'Link copied'). referral-share-btn visible; referral-whatsapp-btn href starts with https://wa.me/ and contains the invite text + link. referral-progress = '0 of 12 free months earned this year.' Design is consistent with the teal dashboard panel. - Logged-out /join?ref=REFHF11GI: referral-banner visible with text 'Demo invited you. Join and pay, and you''ll both get a free month: 13 months for the price of 12.' Invalid ref /join?ref=NOPE1234 -> no referral-banner element (confirmed by query_selector returning null). - Captured ref via /join?ref=... (lib/referral stores in localStorage as gp_ref), then registered a new MEMBER at /register (name+email+password+confirm). Verified link via GET /api/me/referral (as the referrer): friends=[{first_name:'TEST', joined_at:..., paid:false}] i.e. the new member is persisted under users.referred_by -> the member's referral code. No Stripe payment was attempted. === (B) Deal form (Admin + Business) === - /admin/deals -> New deal dialog: 'Image URL' label is completely gone from the DOM (Image URL -> False). The form now shows: * Searchable suburb picker [data-testid=deal-form-suburb-input] with dropdown [data-testid=deal-form-suburb-options] (Victorian suburbs + postcodes). * Image upload component with [data-testid=deal-form-image] (wrapper), [data-testid=deal-form-image-btn] ('Upload photo'), hidden [data-testid=deal-form-image-file] input (accept=image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp), [data-testid=deal-form-image-thumb] (thumbnail img), and [data-testid=deal-form-image-remove] (clears after upload). - Validation: typing 'Zzzinvalid' into the suburb input without selecting from the list, then submitting -> toast error 'Pick the suburb from the list' (matched in sonner). The save is blocked. - Happy path: picked a business (auto-filled suburb from partner), uploaded /app/frontend/public/email/banner.jpg -> POST /partner/deals/image returns a /api/files/go-perks/deals//.jpg URL; thumb switched to that URL; picked 'Richmond 3121' from suburb-options; submitted. Deal saved (verified via GET /api/admin/deals); image_url = https://.../api/files/go-perks/deals/6aea.../931c....jpg. After approving the deal, the public /deals/ page renders with that URL (deal card shows the uploaded photo). Test deal was then deleted via DELETE /api/admin/deals/ -> 200. - Business portal /business: the same DealForm is reused inside [data-testid=business-deal-submit-form]; suburb picker + image upload testids resolved and a TEST_ deal was submitted successfully from the partner side (goes to pending; cleaned up via admin API). === (C) Emails editor === - /admin/emails -> 'Emails to members' group now lists a 'Referral free month' template. - [data-testid=template-item-referral_reward] button text = 'Referral free month'. Clicking it loads the editor; the preview
critical_code_review_comments: ReferralCard.jsx: clipboard write is wrapped in a .then(ok, err) with distinct toasts - good. In the Playwright/headless run (no clipboard-write permission) the error toast fired; consider granting navigator.permissions or falling back to execCommand('copy') for stricter environments. Not a product bug.

DealForm submit guard: 'if (f.suburb && !f.postcode && f.suburb !== (initial.suburb || ''))' toasts 'Pick the suburb from the list' - correctly blocks submit when a user typed a suburb but never picked a list option. Edit flow still allows saving when suburb is unchanged (no postcode re-pick needed) - good.
SuburbPicker uses a module-level 'cache' promise for /places/vic-suburbs - avoids refetch across mounts. Keyboard handling (ArrowUp/Down/Enter/Escape) is wired. Good.

ImageUpload: 5 MB client guard + server MIME validation (via partner/deals/image endpoint); thumb swaps immediately on upload and Remove clears to ''. onChange only called with the stored URL (or '' on remove), keeping form state tidy.
Join.jsx: captureRef() is called in useEffect so the ref persists across the /register navigation; the backend attaches referred_by on account creation. Verified end-to-end.

Radix dialog closes on Escape - a potential testing gotcha: using page.press('Escape') on the suburb input inside the Add Deal dialog closes the whole dialog. Not a product bug but worth noting in context_for_next_testing_agent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all 6 brief items verified (referral card at 390/1440, referral-banner valid+invalid ref, /register linking, admin deal form suburb+upload+validation+persistence+card render, business deal form suburb+upload, Referral free month email template + preview)

rca of the issue: No defects. All three feature changes match the brief end-to-end. Minor testing pitfall uncovered: the Radix dialog used for 'New deal' intercepts the Escape key, so a Playwright script that presses Escape inside the suburb input to blur will close the whole dialog and cause a confusing downstream 'submit button not found' timeout. Fix in tests is to click another input (e.g. deal-form-title) to blur instead. The product form is unaffected - real users use the mouse/tab, which does not close the dialog.
